cohort: 100 pregnant women with pre-existing Type-1 diabetes (mean age at diabetes diagnosis: 15.11 +/- 5.64 years) registered at Baqai Institute of Diabetology and Endocrinology, Pakistan, between January 2022 and January 2023.
finding: Poor management of pre-pregnancy care and poor glycemic control in pregnant women with Type 1 diabetes resulted in compromised maternal and perinatal outcomes, including a high frequency of unplanned pregnancies, cesarean sections, miscarriages, and stillbirths.
mod_finding: 60% of the participants had C-sections (9% emergency, 51% elective) while 40% had normal vaginal deliveries.
birth_weight: Low birth weight in 12 neonates (specific weights not given)
